title.zh: 乘法是面积 · 点阵铺成一块地
title.en: Multiplication Is Area · Arrays Become a Tiled Floor

desc.zh: 先不背口诀，把乘法看成面积：点阵铺成地砖、转个方向读出交换律；一块地切一刀，13×17 自己拆成四块相加——这就是分配律和竖式的来历；最后拿 24 块砖反着拼，反找因数对。
desc.en: Multiplication as area before memorised tables: dot arrays become tiled floors, a quarter-turn shows commutativity, and one cut through a plot splits 13×17 into four blocks that add back up — where the distributive law and the written algorithm come from; ends by factoring 24 tiles in reverse.
